source.stem:
Magnesium nitride is formed when magnesium burns in air. Magnesium nitride is an ionic compound.

What is the formula of magnesium nitride?

mx.teacher_note: air is the same as its neighbouring term in this chapter, so the decision does not change.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: The decision still holds even if we ignore this condition: Applies when the syringe opening is closed so the air cannot escape.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: gas particles forced closer -> decreased air volume happens first, and that produces external push on the plunger.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: This rule applies even when Applies when the syringe opening is closed so the air cannot escape is not true.

intelligence.enrichment: Gas can be compressed because there are large spaces between its particles; pushing the plunger forces the gas particles closer together and decreases the volume of air. external push on the plunger -> gas particles forced closer -> decreased air volume The learner explains that closing the syringe prevents escape and pushing the plunger decreases air volume by forcing gas particles closer together in their large interparticle spaces. Compressed air must have leaked out, because the same gas cannot occupy a smaller volume.
